reason: The first implementation would have counted the declared round-trip cost twice by shifting entry/exit prices and adding the same fee terms again.
The raw target inherited the cost-adjusted entry and would therefore move when the cost profile changed.
Funding fallback used the last prior mark rather than the exact same-timestamp contract open.
Rolling features could cross a source gap, and the first workflow would download later-stage archives before prior gates passed.
The 5x leverage cap was declared but not applied to account NAV returns.

fixed_contract.cost: the declared all-in round-trip bps is split once between entry and exit
fixed_contract.target: raw target is fixed from the raw next-open price and raw structural stop before applying cost
fixed_contract.funding: official mark open at the exact settlement timestamp, with exact contract-open fallback only; no prior or forward fill
fixed_contract.gaps: rolling states restart at every non-five-minute source gap
fixed_contract.stage_seal: 2023 and 2024 archives are not downloaded or read unless the preceding registered gate passes
fixed_contract.account_nav: actual per-trade risk is min(1% NAV, 5x leverage times unit risk/entry)
